{{Top|leg}}
The '''Governor of Telos''' was a [[Politics/Legends|political]] title used by the reigning [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Telos IV]]. In [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]] the title was held by [[Crion]], the father of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xanatos]]. Xanatos betrayed Jinn during the [[Telosian Civil War]] in that year, and during that conflict Crion was killed. [[Hukowl An Devi]], Crion's [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] advisor, became the new governor. When Jinn returned to Telos with his new Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], there was [[Unidentified Governor of Telos|another governor]].
